verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official, documented programmatic surfaces to build against: a REST API with version headers, the Events API v2, V3 webhooks, and an official MCP server listed under a 'tool-libraries' docs section. However, no item names an official language SDK or client library. That leaves only API-level building blocks rather than SDKs. Missing for 10: any named official SDKs or client libraries (e.g., Python/Go/Node), SDK install or usage docs, and independent corroboration of SDK quality.
